section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the primary service in exile is through yichuda tata'ah (lower unity), which requires the power and illumination from yichuda ila'ah (higher unity) achieved through the study of the inner dimensions of Torah.
section.t: b)
And the explanation is,
as explained at length in Kuntres Eitz HaChayim137,
that the service stemming from Yichuda Tata'ah is in the aspect of "After Hashem your G-d you shall go,"
and the service stemming from Yichuda Ila'ah is in the aspect of self-nullification (bitul bimetziut)
(meaning that the aspects of Yichuda Ila'ah and Yichuda Tata'ah are aspects of "face" and "back" in service).
And now138
the Torah speaks mostly,
and particularly in the time of exile,
about the primary service being in the aspect of Yichuda Tata'ah
("After Hashem your G-d you shall go"),
but even then there must be a remembrance of the service in the aspect of Yichuda Ila'ah
[a remembrance similar to the remembrance of Amalek.
For Amalek is the letters of "Melek" (wringing the neck),
from the term "and he shall wring its head from opposite its nape"81,
meaning that its place of sustenance is in the aspect of "back" and its function is to cause forgetfulness
(as above, that the matter of forgetfulness stems from the aspect of "back").
Therefore the verse specifically warns regarding it: "Remember, do not forget"139].
That from time to time, at least, his service must be in the aspect of Yichuda Ila'ah,
in order for his service in the aspect of Yichuda Tata'ah to have endurance, it requires the giving of power and illumination from the service in the aspect of Yichuda Ila'ah.
And the aspect of Yichuda Ila'ah illuminates within the aspect of Yichuda Tata'ah.
And the aspect of Yichuda Ila'ah
(which gives power for the endurance of the service in the aspect of Yichuda Tata'ah)
is connected with the study of the inner dimension of Torah (Pnimiyut HaTorah),
as explained there140
that the matter of Pnimiyut HaTorah is as it is written141
"Know the G-d of your father,"
meaning to know His greatness etc., and through this is brought about
(as the conclusion of the verse)
"and serve Him with a whole heart,"
that the service is in completeness
(this being as above, that the aspect of the "face" of Torah
(Pnimiyut HaTorah)
is connected with the aspect of "face" in service,
the service in the aspect of Yichuda Ila'ah).

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the ultimate purpose is for the essential Divine Presence to be in the lower realms, achieved through our service in exile which draws down the revelation of the inner aspect of the Infinite Light in the future.
section.t: c)
And in general,
this is
(that the aspect of "face" will be drawn down also into the aspect of "back")
that the ultimate intention is that the primary Shechinah be in the lower realms.
And as explained in Pri Etz Chayim142
that all our deeds and service during the time of exile only reach the aspect of the externality of the Infinite Light (Atik),
and in the future there will be the revelation of the aspect of the inner dimension of the Infinite Light (Pnimiyut Atik).
Nevertheless, our deeds and service during the time of exile draw down the reward of the days of Moshiach and what follows143,
the general concept of which is as it is written144
"Your Teacher will no longer be hidden,"
and "the glory of Hashem will be revealed and all flesh will see together"145
until it reaches the aspect of "face to face,"
that the aspect of the inner dimension of the Infinite Light (Pnimiyut Atik) will be revealed.
And what we accomplish now is through the fact that in the time of exile there is the empowering force of the inner dimension of Torah
(which stems from the aspect of the inner dimension of the Infinite Light),
for "those who taste it merit life"146.
And the inner dimension of Torah leads to service in the aspect of self-nullification (bitul bimetziut),
which leads to service whose general concept is Yichuda Ila'ah,
and this service is connected with the inner dimension of the soul,
as explained in many places,
and this is a close preparation for drawing down something similar
(to this service),
in the measure of the Holy One, blessed be He, which is measure for measure129,
meaning that specifically through "your springs will burst forth outward"
(the aspect of the inner dimension of Torah stemming from the aspect of the inner dimension of the Infinite Light etc., which brings about service stemming from the inner dimension of the soul etc.)
"will come the Master, King Moshiach"
(the revelation of the aspect of the inner dimension of the Infinite Light,
the primary Shechinah,
in the lower realms).

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the entire point of the maamar is to draw the aspect of "face" into "back," like the yud in the dalet, which is the essential Divine Presence in the lower realms, accomplished through the service of the leaders of Israel in each generation.
section.t: d)
And this is
(the drawing down of the aspect of "face" into "back,"
like the yud in the dalet)
also the general point of the maamar of the Baal HaHilula,
whose beginning is "I have come to My garden, My orchard,"
to the place which was My primary dwelling initially, that the primary Shechinah was in the lower realms,
and it is understood that what is said
(in the Midrash)
"primary Shechinah,"
the intention is the inner dimension of the Shechinah150,
which is connected to the inner dimension of what is above, up to the aspect of the inner dimension of the Infinite Light (Pnimiyut Atik).
And this aspect must be specifically in the lower realms,
and this is accomplished through the service of man,
until through service they effect, as the maamar concludes151,
that they "set up the legions of Hashem,"
and "open the hidden treasures,"
and all the precious wealth in the treasures which his fathers and the king himself gathered are distributed to the men of the army by the officers of the legion and the heads of the army,
which refers,
in general,
to "your heads to your tribes,"
the heads and princes of Israel in every generation,
for "the extension of Moshe is in every generation"152
until the prince of our generation, the Baal HaHilula,
and "they will awaken and sing, dwellers of the dust"153
and he is among them, and he will lead us upright to our land very soon,
to greet Moshiach our righteousness who will teach Torah to the entire nation154,
the inner dimension of Torah,
and speedily in our days.
